_comment: PG-5 states: 'The register is not created in P02 - it is a P05 operational artifact (DEP-P02-04).'
This file is that artifact, scoped to the single local deterministic feed.
PI-1: 'provider' is a program-internal stable identity token. It is NOT a vendor name,
brand, hostname, account or product SKU.
PI-3: immutable once issued. A different source is a DIFFERENT provider identity.
PI-6: never exposed in product DTOs or UI (NFR-06).
A-23 / SM-4: no credential, token, key, secret or endpoint URL may appear here.
DETERMINISM: every value below is a fixed literal. There is no wall-clock, random or
environmental input anywhere in this register.

issued.description: Local deterministic fixture feed for development and certification. Synthetic data only.
issued.notes: PI-2: stable across adapter swaps. PI-4: participates in snapshotId, never renamed.

prohibitedHere: A-23: no credential, token, key, secret or endpoint URL
SM-4: no endpoint, hostname, account identifier, key or credential in source metadata
PR-8 / FR-2: no secret material in any evidence record
